question: LRU cache steady state threshold inter arrival time heavy tail distribution

sources.title: Network cache design under stationary requests: Exact analysis and ...
sources.snippet: This is an important case since it is used to model bursty and heavy tailed behavior of inter-request time distribution. We also formulate a reverse engineering based dual implementation of LRU in HRB-CUM framework under stationary arrivals.

sources.title: LRU Cache Design: Eviction Strategies and Trade-offs
sources.snippet: From the classic hash map + doubly linked list LRU to modern eviction strategies like 2Q, ARC, SIEVE, and W-TinyLFU — understand the trade-offs between recency, frequency, memory overhead, and concurrency in cache design.
